```{=html}
<style>
  .slides-gallery-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 340px));
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }

  .slide-window-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    background-color: #0d1117;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #f0f6fc;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .slide-window-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    border-color: #58a6ff;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.22);
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #f0f6fc;
  }

  /* Window Chrome Header */
  .window-chrome {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(48, 54, 61, 0.8);
    padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
  }

  .window-dots {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .window-dot {
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .dot-red { background: #ff5f56; }
  .dot-yellow { background: #ffbd2e; }
  .dot-green { background: #27c93f; }

  .window-session-tag {
    font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #58a6ff;
    background: rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.12);
    padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.3);
  }

  /* Miniature Slide Preview Area */
  .window-preview {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 1.25rem 0.25rem;
  }

  .window-preview-term {
    font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #58a6ff;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .window-preview-title {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 40%, #8b949e 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }

  .window-preview-desc {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    color: #8b949e;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  /* Window Footer Bar */
  .window-footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(48, 54, 61, 0.8);
    padding-top: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #8b949e;
  }

  .slide-count-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: #8b949e;
  }

  .slide-count-badge::before {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #3fb950;
  }

  .launch-prompt {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #58a6ff;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
  }

  .slide-window-card:hover .launch-prompt {
    transform: translateX(3px);
  }
</style>

<div class="slides-gallery-grid">
  <!-- Git and GitHub Collaboration Card Window -->
  <a href="collaborating.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="slide-window-card" title="Open Git and GitHub Collaboration Slides">
    <div class="window-chrome">
      <div class="window-dots">
        <span class="window-dot dot-red"></span>
        <span class="window-dot dot-yellow"></span>
        <span class="window-dot dot-green"></span>
      </div>
      <span class="window-session-tag">Session 1</span>
    </div>
    
    <div class="window-preview">
      <div class="window-preview-term">AY 2026 T1</div>
      <div class="window-preview-title">Git &amp; GitHub Collaboration</div>
      <div class="window-preview-desc">Workflows for scientific collaboration, branches, commits, remotes, and pull requests.</div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="window-footer">
      <span class="slide-count-badge">23 slides</span>
      <span class="launch-prompt">Launch deck &rarr;</span>
    </div>
  </a>
</div>
```
